project.title: Bacterial and fungal diversity of indoor exhibitory rooms of Wawel Royal Castle in Krakow, Poland
project.description: The main aims of the study were to (i) determine the diversity of airborne bacteria and fungi of Wawel Royal Castle; (ii) evaluate differences between the results obtained with the application of the culture-dependent and culture-independent methodologies used for studying air microbiome; (iii) compare native microbial communities suspended in the air and deposited onto the historical surfaces; (iv) test the stability of microbial community within summer season characterized by high tourist traffic.
project.center_name: Research & Development Life Sciences Limited Company
